items.fact: Precision = TP/(TP+FP), 'of everything I flagged positive, how much was right'
items.where: Reading section 1 table

items.fact: Recall = TPR = sensitivity = TP/(TP+FN), 'of all actual positives, how many I caught'
items.where: Reading section 1 table

items.fact: F1 = 2PR/(P+R), harmonic mean
items.where: Reading section 1 table

items.fact: FPR = FP/(FP+TN), fraction of negatives wrongly flagged
items.where: Reading section 1 table

items.fact: TNR (specificity) = TN/(TN+FP) = 1 - FPR
items.where: Reading section 1 table

items.fact: Why ROC misleads on imbalanced data: FPR denominator is the huge negative class; thousands of extra FPs barely move FPR while recall moves; ROC looks great regardless

items.fact: Entropy H(P) = -sum P log P, average bits with P's own optimal code
items.where: Reading 'Information quantities' (summary); full widget on the root, thread 1 (linked)

items.fact: Cross entropy H(P,Q) = -sum P log Q, bits using a code built for Q

items.fact: KL = H(P,Q) - H(P) = sum P log(P/Q); extra bits for wrong code; asymmetric; no triangle inequality
items.where: Reading 'Information quantities'; root thread 1

items.fact: Minimising CE wrt Q = minimising KL since H(P) fixed; one-hot: H(P)=0 and CE = KL = NLL of true class
items.where: Reading 'Information quantities'; root thread 1
